status: Basic-zone tuning implemented with the latest user overrides. These are design coverage targets; actual generated coverage is measured separately. Signature gaps and suggestions are not implemented.
metric: Percentage of eligible 7 m ground cells occupied by stationary elements. Targets are occupied-cell budgets, not direct per-attempt spawn probabilities.

GRASS.intent: Open grass clumps and ordinary flowers; no marigolds. Butterflies now favor grass instead of forest.

FOREST.intent: Canopy and fungi: tree stands, nut litter and mushrooms; fewer shrubs so the canopy reads clearly. No crimson ore or butterflies.

SAND.intent: Mostly open sand, with shells and driftwood concentrated along the tide line. Plain rocks use the beach rock appearance.

FARMLAND.intent: Private ground: no generated plants, objects, wildlife or enemies, including edges and POI rewards.

RESIDENTIAL.intent: Keep mushrooms and existing rock-lined street verges. Remove long grass; retain sparse shrubs. Street rubble follows the road network rather than a new residential scatter. Street rocks contain no ore.

PARK.intent: Keep the four park characters distinct. Targets below apply only outside nexus coverage.

ROCK.intent: Natural outcrop clusters: stone with visible ore pockets and broad clear gaps.

SCHOOL.intent: Open grounds with small blue forget-me-not beds at accessible edges; no marigold scatter.

COMMERCIAL.intent: Geometric hedge and pot rows around clear plazas; avoid a meadow-like flower scatter.

INDUSTRIAL.intent: Worked rubble and salvage barrels with clear aisles; fewer stone piles than natural rock. Ore stays uncommon.

PLAYGROUND.intent: Open play space; a few ordinary flowers and grass tufts at the edges.

PITCH.intent: Keep the field centre clear; only sparse edge grass. No rocks or ores, including roadside rubble.

WETLAND.intent: Reedy grass bands and damp mushrooms around open channels; no flowers, rocks or ores, including roadside scatter.

GOLF.intent: Private ground: no generated plants, objects, wildlife or enemies, including edges and POI rewards.

ORCHARD.intent: Fruit trees and light grass only along eligible orchard edges; interiors stay empty. No rocks, ores, bats, butterflies or spiders. Source farmland restrictions still take priority.

WASTELAND.intent: Irregular rubble and scrub patches, visibly rougher than residential frontage.

meadow.intent: Open lawn with concentrated wildflower patches.

wooded.intent: Small tree stands and sparse shrubs. No ordinary park mushrooms.

formal.intent: Straight clipped hedge rows and bounded marigold beds.

common.intent: Mostly open lawn with a few irregular tufts.
